summary: The session discusses the need to rethink data management in the context of agentic AI, emphasizing the importance of data observability and convergence of data management platforms. It highlights the challenges posed by fragmented systems and the necessity for real-time data processing to meet the demands of AI. The speaker presents a vision for a unified platform that integrates various data management functions to enhance operational efficiency and responsiveness.

sections.topic: Introduction to Data Management in AI Era
key_points: Data management must be rethought in the context of agentic AI.
Data observability is crucial for real-time data processing.
Current data delivery systems are too slow for AI demands.
Fragmentation leads to inefficiencies in data management.
True convergence is necessary, not just integration.
Redundant products must be unified for effective data management.
Design time products focus on governance and catalogs.
Runtime products are essential for observing data flow.

sections.topic: Role of Agents in Data Management
key_points: Agents simplify complexity in data management.
Human oversight is crucial in the agentic management process.
The architecture must support large data loads efficiently.
Scalability is critical for processing high volumes of data.
The journey to full automation involves phases of human oversight.
Confidence in AI decisions grows with human feedback.
mCP servers enhance data accessibility across systems.
Distributed computing architecture is vital for handling large queries.
A converged platform can significantly improve data management.
Attendees are invited to learn more at the upcoming customer conference.

key_takeaways: Rethink data management strategies to align with agentic AI demands.
Implement data observability to ensure real-time data quality.
Converge fragmented data management systems into a unified platform.
